classificationReason: Current test failure is a script locator issue, not an application defect

currentFailure.action: Click the search icon in the shell bar
currentFailure.error: Timeout 90000ms exceeded waiting for locator to be visible
currentFailure.rootCause: SAP Fiori shell bar lazy-loads the 'Open Search' button. It's not in the DOM immediately after login. Requires clicking 'Open Menu' button first to trigger full shell bar render.
currentFailure.sapBehaviorNote: SAP is functioning correctly. The search button exists and works as expected once the shell bar is fully initialized. This is a UI lazy-loading pattern, not an application defect.

prerequisiteAction.description: Click 'Open Menu' button before attempting to click 'Open Search'
prerequisiteAction.reason: SAP Fiori shell bar does not render 'Open Search' button until navigation menu is toggled once

reExecutionResult.patchStrategy: Add prerequisite step in openSearch() method: if 'Open Search' button not immediately visible, click 'Open Menu' button once to trigger full shell bar render, then proceed with clicking 'Open Search'.

acViolationAnalysis.tcDesignedPurpose: TC-CS-021 is designed to validate AC-6: 'A unique Standard Purchase Order number is generated and displayed upon successful order submission.' The test expects a dedicated success confirmation notification (toast, banner, or dialog) that explicitly shows the PO number.
acViolationAnalysis.acText: A unique Standard Purchase Order number is generated and displayed upon successful order submission.
acViolationAnalysis.knownSapBehavior: SAP displays the PO number inside the document heading as a link (e.g., 'Purchase Order 4500065467') but does NOT display a dedicated success notification toast, banner, or dialog. No explicit 'created successfully' confirmation separate from the document itself.

existingDefect.summary: [MM] TC-CS-021: PO success notification does not display generated PO number — AC-6 violated
existingDefect.note: The AC-6 defect is already logged and tracked in Jira. No need to create a duplicate defect.

comparisonToAcceptanceCriteria.acText: A unique Standard Purchase Order number is generated and displayed upon successful order submission.
comparisonToAcceptanceCriteria.expectedBehavior: A dedicated success confirmation notification appears immediately after clicking Order (toast, banner, dialog, or equivalent) that explicitly states the Purchase Order was created and displays the 10-digit PO number prominently.
comparisonToAcceptanceCriteria.actualSapBehavior: SAP displays the PO number inside the document heading as a link but does not display a dedicated success notification separate from the document content.

decision.reason: Two-part decision: (1) Current failure is an automation script bug (locator issue), not an app defect. (2) The underlying AC-6 violation that TC-CS-021 is designed to test is already logged as Bug CS-6 with multiple re-confirmations.

recommendedActions.purpose: Patch the openSearch() method to handle SAP shell bar lazy-loading by clicking 'Open Menu' before 'Open Search'
recommendedActions.outcome: Once patched, the test will successfully navigate to the app and reach the designed assertion failure on AC-6 (success notification)

recommendedActions.purpose: Review the existing defect for AC-6 violation. It has been confirmed 3 times across multiple pipeline runs.
recommendedActions.outcome: Defect remains open. No further action needed unless SAP behavior changes.

summary.currentFailureClassification: AUTOMATION_BUG — Script needs patch for shell bar initialization
